scope: For any symmetric cubic S on R^n and scalars lambda,mu_i, form T with X0=diag(lambda,D), Xi=[[0,mu_i e_i^t],[mu_i e_i,S_i]], D=diag(mu). No maximum hypothesis needed for these identities.
derivation: B(T) restricted to S coordinates equals B(S)+2D^2, and its off-diagonal first column is h. Expand the squared Gram defect.
Commutators [X0,Xi] give 2L+Q. Tangent-pair off-diagonal blocks give another Q. Their bottom blocks are [Si,Sj]+mu_i mu_j(Eij-Eji).
Writing W=sum_ijk mu_i mu_j S_ijk^2 gives the summed cross term2(H-W), Q=2(A-W), and pure wedge squared norm M^2-M4. Substitute.
diagnostic: 48 deterministic rational block tensors with n=1,2,3,4 and12 cases each, seed22469, all three identities checked with exact Fraction matrix multiplication. This supports algebra only and is not the general proof.
limitation: The combined difference has no established sign. This removes the coarse global sqrt(C) triangle estimate in the bookkeeping, but establishes no globally decreasing potential, global theorem, or acceptance.
